description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/complaint-process">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Customer complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Customer refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies customer of decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Provides refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides satisfaction feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle customer complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RelevantDepartment" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund" name="Determine complaint validity and whether a refund is justified"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of the decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Continue after refund decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplaintToLog" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogToAssign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToReview" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDetermine" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineToNotify" sourceRef="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToDecision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReimbursementToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedToEnd" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer complaint and feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Ready to file a complaint"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint about product or service"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_CustomerRefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive refund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" name="Continue after refund decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Provide feedback?" default="Flow_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Continue after optional feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToFile" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileToReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecisionToChoice" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundReceivedToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerMergeToFeedbackChoice" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerProvidesFeedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackMergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
